title: Upgrading IOS: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Upgrading a router is a lot like updating a phone. You download the new version first. Then you restart onto it.

scenes.heading: Upgrade steps
scenes.narration: Here's the sequence. Check the current version. Check there's room in flash. Copy the image from the server. Set the boot variable to the new file. Save, then reload.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Source first, then destination. Set the boot variable to the new file. Reload asks first, and can be cancelled.

items.wrong: copy tftp flash goes to the server
Overwrite the old file to upgrade
